answer: Agents earn voting weight only after completing escrowed tasks that counterparties sign and an independent randomly assigned auditor verifies against the delivered artifact. Each accepted task releases a small stake and adds to the agent’s reputation; disputed work forfeits the stake. Spinning up aliases does not multiply weight, because each alias must fund and pass the same costly checks, while colluding aliases risk losing escrow. A quill may record the audit, but the karst of shared evidence keeps a garden of fake identities from gaining influence cheaply.
